notes: Item 19 contains two parts. Part I covers Registration Revenue (registration sales only, excluding sponsorships, commissions, merchandise, concession sales) for 224 Covered Units operated throughout the full Measurement Period (Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2024). Chart 1 provides total/bottom-half/top-half breakdowns. Chart 2 provides average registration revenue segmented by number of venues operated (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6+ venues). Part II covers a full income statement (Sales to Cost Analysis) for 135 Included Franchises that operated throughout the Reporting Period (Oct 1, 2023 – Sep 30, 2024) and reported materially complete financials. All values are annual averages unless otherwise noted. Operating Profit excludes owner compensation, charitable contributions, meals/entertainment, monthly franchise fee (5-year agreement option), interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, finance charges, and other miscellaneous non-operating expenses.
